findings.description: `math.add` looks like a side-effecting tool (its name contains a mutation verb), but its `side_effects` declaration is [Read]. A policy synthesizer cannot produce safe rules for this tool because it cannot tell what it actually does.
findings.remediation: Declare the tool's true side effects explicitly. If the tool is genuinely read-only, rename it to match (e.g. `email.preview` rather than `email.send`).
findings.title: Tool `math.add` name implies a side effect that is not declared
